Street Lighting.reason: Burnt out bulb or failed LED driver unit
Interrupted local power line or tripped breaker
Corroded wires, loose connections, or underground cable breakdown
Defective automatic light sensor or timer switch
Accidental damage, storm damage, or vandalism

Drinking Water Quality.reason: Dissolved metallic ions (iron, manganese, zinc) or industrial seepage
Rusted or cracked supply pipes allowing soil or dirty water ingress
Sub-optimal chlorination or filter breakdown at filtration plant
Cross-contamination between broken sewer line and drinking pipeline

Sanitation & Sewerage.reason: Accumulation of solid waste, sludge, or tree roots obstructing sewer flow
Structural failure of underground hume pipe causing sewage backflow
Vandalism, heavy vehicle impact, or missing cast-iron slab

Sanitation & Sewerage.cause: Lack of water supply at public facility
Sanitation & Sewerage.reason: Faulty pump or disconnected water connection in public toilet

Groundwater.reason: High natural iron, fluoride, or heavy mineral concentration in groundwater
Cracked casing allowing surface runoff into well
Untreated factory discharge percolating into local aquifer

Roads & Potholes.reason: Poor sub-base drainage leading to asphalt cracking under vehicle loads
Low-bitumen aggregate mix degrading rapidly under heavy traffic
Excess bitumen bleeding or oil spill creating slippery road surface
Unsealed utility road cuts made for pipe or cable laying

Public Drainage.reason: Accumulation of plastic waste, silt, and garbage in drain channel
Drain dimensions insufficient for storm monsoon runoff volume
Broken concrete slabs or collapsed sidewalls obstructing flow

Building Maintenance.cause: Lack of exhaust / passive air vents
Building Maintenance.reason: Inadequate windows or non-functional exhaust fans restricting airflow
Aged concrete tarring or structural cracks allowing rainwater seepage
Long-term weathering and unaddressed wall dampness

Traffic Management.reason: Burnt relay circuit or corrupted signal timing logic
Grid outage coupled with depleted backup battery UPS
Individual red/yellow/green signal LED lamp failure

Digital & Connectivity.reason: Inadequate cell tower density or physical terrain blockage
Cut underground optical fibre cable or backhaul congestion

Urban Accessibility.reason: Bus stop built without ramp or tactile paving for universal access
Vendor stalls or parked vehicles blocking accessible pedestrian route

School Infrastructure.reason: Aged roof tarring or cracked terrace concrete allowing rainwater seepage
Debris accumulation preventing roof drainage during heavy rain

School Infrastructure.cause: Lack of dedicated drinking water filtration
School Infrastructure.reason: Disconnected overhead tank or missing water filter unit

Hospital Services.reason: High patient volume exceeding available doctor duty slots
Central medical store procurement or distribution delay
Manual registration counter slowdowns creating crowding

Solid Waste Management.reason: Unserviceable garbage compaction trucks or route skips
Insufficient community bins leading to open dumping and stray animal attraction

Air Pollution.reason: Non-functional industrial scrubber or particulate baghouse filter

Air Pollution.cause: Open burning of waste or biomass
Air Pollution.reason: Illegal burning of municipal waste or crop residue nearby

Power Grid & Transformers.reason: Peak summer load exceeding transformer kVA rating
Weathering or bird strike causing high-voltage line trip and fuse blow

Irrigation Systems.reason: Silt accumulation or unmaintained canal bank obstructing water flow to tail-end fields
Burnout of lift-irrigation motor or intake valve blockage

Generic.reason: Delayed routine maintenance or unaddressed wear and tear
Demand exceeding current infrastructure design limits
Weather extremes or unforeseen physical damage
